import { Controller, Get, Patch, Post, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';

export class AuditGuard {}

export class NotesService {
  findAll(): string[] {
    return ['after'];
  }

  findOne(id: string): string {
    return id;
  }

  create(title: string): string {
    return title.trim();
  }

  update(id: string, title: string): string {
    return `${id}:${title}`;
  }
}

@Controller('notes')
export class NotesController {
  constructor(private readonly notes: NotesService) {}

  // CASE:comparison-modified-handler
  @Get()
  findAll(): string[] {
    return this.notes.findAll();
  }

  // CASE:comparison-unchanged-endpoint
  @Post()
  @UseGuards(AuditGuard)
  create(title: string): string {
    return this.notes.create(title);
  }

  // CASE:comparison-added-endpoint
  @Patch(':id')
  update(id: string, title: string): string {
    return this.notes.update(id, title);
  }
}
